entry_points: main.py main (argparse: --method {natural_niches, ga, map_elites, cma_es, brute_force}, --pop_size 20, --runs 10, --total_forward_passes 50000, --no_crossover, --no_splitpoint, --no_matchmaker, --use_pre_trained; forces JAX_PLATFORM_NAME=cpu; pickles results to results/<method>[_flags].pkl)
natural_niches_fn.py run_natural_niches (the M2N2 loop; alpha=1.0 gives natural niches, alpha=0.0 is the 'ga' baseline)

natural_niches_fn.py sample_parents (fitness-proportional parent 1 with per-datapoint competition normalisation z**alpha; 'matchmaker' picks parent 2 by how much it out-scores parent 1 on individual datapoints)
natural_niches_fn.py update_archive (jit: append child scores, recompute niche-normalised fitness, evict the worst individual if the child is not the worst)

helper_fn.py crossover / slerp_w_splitpoint / crossover_without_splitpoint / mutate (SLERP merge of two flat parameter vectors with a random split point flipping the interpolation weight; Gaussian mutation std 0.01)
helper_fn.py get_pre_trained_models (trains two MLPs with optax Adam on digits 0-4 and 5-9 respectively, 10 epochs, seed 42)
map_elites_fn.py run_map_elites / update_archive / sample_parents (baseline: 10x10 grid over odd-digit and even-digit accuracy, quality = overall train accuracy)
cma_es_fn.py run_cma_es and brute_force_fn.py run_brute_force (baselines: pycma over the flat param vector; grid search over 10000 SLERP weights between the two pre-trained models)
model.py mlp / get_acc / train (64-256-10 ReLU MLP on a flat parameter vector, num_params = 19210)
example_input: No input files; sklearn digits dataset (first 80% train, last 20% test) and CLI flags, e.g. 'python main.py --method ga --no_crossover' or 'python main.py --method map_elites --use_pre_trained'
example_output: results/<method>[_no_crossover|_no_splitpoint|_no_matchmaker][_pre_trained].pkl containing, per run, dict of 'evals', 'test_values' (test accuracy of the best-train individual after every forward pass) and optionally 'train_values'; printed 'Run {run}, Forward pass {i}, Test acc: {acc}' every 1000 passes; figure.png in README shows test-accuracy curves for the methods
runtime_native_deps: JAX 0.4.31 with jaxlib (CPU forced by main.py via JAX_PLATFORM_NAME=cpu; environment.yml nonetheless pins CUDA 12 jax plugin and nvidia-*-cu12 wheels)
host_class: Linux x86_64 (environment.yml pins linux-64 conda builds) with CPython 3.11; CPU-only at runtime despite CUDA wheels in the env; small memory footprint (19210-parameter MLP on 1797 samples)
upstream_docs: booktitle={Proceedings of the 2025 genetic and evolutionary computation conference}, pages={1217--1225}, year={2025}
built_to: Reproduce the GECCO 2025 paper's results showing that M2N2 (Model Merging with Natural Niches) 'can achieve comparable results to CMA-ES when evolving MNIST classifiers from scratch, and it is the best method to evolve pre-trained models' (README).
pressure: NOT_FOUND_AT_PIN (README states the claim but not the motivating limitation; the paper abstract is not in the tree)
success_means: Test accuracy of the best-on-train individual as a function of forward passes (evaluations), compared across natural_niches, ga, map_elites, cma_es and brute_force, from scratch and from pre-trained models, plotted in plotting.ipynb / figure.png (README).
main_loop_one_sentence: run_natural_niches keeps a fixed-size archive of flat MLP parameter vectors with a boolean per-training-example score matrix, and for each of total_forward_passes iterations samples parent 1 proportional to competition-normalised fitness (each example's reward divided by the number of archive members that get it right, to the power alpha), samples parent 2 by a 'matchmaker' score favouring individuals that are correct where parent 1 is wrong, produces a child by split-point SLERP crossover plus Gaussian mutation (mutation skipped when starting from pre-trained models), evaluates the child on the training set, and replaces the lowest-fitness archive member if the child is not itself the worst.
behavioral_entry_point: natural_niches_fn.py:sample_parents (competition alpha and matchmaker attraction), natural_niches_fn.py:update_archive (eviction rule), helper_fn.py:crossover / mutate (merge operator and noise std), main.py:parse_arguments (ablation flags)
